about_the_game:
『Roger That』 is a tactical battle royale game that immerses players in intense combat across war-torn battlegrounds.

Players become elite operatives with unique abilities, working closely with their squad through voice comms to strategize and survive.

As the operational zone rapidly shrinks, gathering weapons, gear, and intel becomes critical, demanding quick decision-making and tactical movement over sheer shooting skill.

Features like real-time voice communication and drone reconnaissance add a new layer of strategy, shifting the tide of battle in an instant.

Combining team-based gameplay with realistic combat elements, 『Roger That』 delivers a uniquely immersive and intense battle royale experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages or may not be appropriate for use at work.

Contains excessive violence and gore in the game.

There are battles with monsters on a map with a scary atmosphere, and there are corpses and blood effects.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
